claim: In a phone browser with no sign-up, Puzzle Press makes a free 50-puzzle, 108-page large-print Christmas word search interior PDF at 8.5x11, with its solutions, and its full-wrap KDP cover; the free book carries one footer line and a PREVIEW cover, and $19 once removes them.
notes: Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It types the title, picks 8.5x11, ticks Large print, swaps the default theme for Christmas, downloads the interior (108 pages, read from the PDF) and the cover (the price dialog shows, then closes), and ends on puzzle 1, its solution and the cover, rendered from those files. The final 2.2 s hold the cover still for the end card.
